query.defaultValue: subscription { EVM(network: eth, trigger_on: head) { Blocks { Block { BaseFee BaseFeeInUSD Bloom Coinbase } } } }

aiMetadata.description: Fires whenever the subscribed GraphQL subscription pushes a new event over its websocket connection. Each fire delivers one event payload matching the configured subscription query, representing a real-time update streamed from the GraphQL server (for example a new blockchain block or transaction). Use this to react to live data the moment the GraphQL endpoint emits it.
